stories.title: "Malfoid": X falls for a female Draco Malfoy
stories.summary: "Malfoid", fan art imagining Draco Malfoy as a blonde Slytherin girl, took over X: artists posted their own versions by the dozen, Korean and Japanese fans traded jokes about a 110-chapter Harry x Malfoid fanfic, and posts like "This Week’s Trending: The Bread / The Circus" framed it as the meme of the week. Explainers followed the next day.
